delete columns.description: delete named columns from a table

join.description: left/inner/right join two tables on matching symbol columns

lazy pipeline.body:
${1:plan}: lazy select ${2:cols} from load "${3:path.parquet}" where ${4:pred}
${1:plan} sink "${5:out.parquet}"
lazy pipeline.description: bind a lazy plan and sink it to disk without materialising early

like.description: q-glob match: * any sequence, ? one char, [..] a class

ipc dispatch.description: hopen a connection and dispatch a statement to it (ipc feature)

ipc write handle.description: open a write handle and dispatch an assignment/sink to it (ipc feature)

conditional.description: ?[cond; then; cond; then; ...; else] conditional expression

function.description: bind a function: name: {[params] stmt; stmt; last-expr}

lambda.description: an anonymous function literal - a value, so it can be passed, returned or applied in place

while.description: while[test; s1; s2; ...] — loop while the boolean test holds
